title: Failure Detection for Surgical Robot Imitation Policies via Flow-Matching World Modeling
description:
arXiv:2607.27511v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Imitation learning has shown increasing promise for autonomous robotic surgery, yet safe deployment remains challenging due to the safety-critical nature of surgical tasks and the complexity and variability of surgical environments. Failure detection is therefore an essential safeguard, but its development remains difficult due to the challenges of scarce failure data, highly variable manipulation dynamics, and the need to balance missed detection
